license_required.quote: No person shall practice dentistry unless he possesses a current valid license from the Board of Dentistry.

moral_character_required.quote: satisfactory proof that the applicant (i) is of good moral character

degree_required.value: Graduate of an accredited dental school or college, or dental department of an institution of higher education
degree_required.quote: is a graduate of an accredited dental school or college, or dental department of an institution of higher education

accrediting_body.value: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association
accrediting_body.quote: Accept for licensure such applicants for a dentist license who graduate from a predoctoral dental education program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation

exams.name: Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations
exams.quote: has passed all parts of the examination given by the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations

exams.name: Clinical examination acceptable to the Board
exams.quote: has successfully completed a clinical examination acceptable to the Board

required.quote: The Board shall promulgate regulations requiring continuing education for any dental license renewal or reinstatement.

available.quote: The Board may grant a license to practice dentistry to an applicant licensed to practice in another jurisdiction

requirements.value: Must meet standard requirements, hold a current unrestricted license in another US jurisdiction in good standing, have not committed grounds for denial, and have been in continuous clinical practice for five out of the six years immediately preceding application.
requirements.quote: holds a current, unrestricted license to practice dentistry in another jurisdiction in the United States and is certified to be in good standing by each jurisdiction in which he currently holds or has held a license; (iii) has not committed any act that would constitute grounds for denial as set forth in § 54.1-2706; and (iv) has been in continuous clinical practice for five out of the six years immediately preceding application for licensure

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice dentistry unless he possesses a current valid license from the Board of Dentistry.

credential_type.quote: "License" means the document issued to an applicant upon completion of requirements for admission to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in the Commonwealth

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice dentistry unless he possesses a current valid license from the Board of Dentistry.

title_protection.quote: Any person shall be deemed to be practicing dentistry who (i) uses the words dentist, or dental surgeon, the letters D.D.S., D.M.D., or any letters or title in connection with his name, which in any way represents him as engaged in the practice of dentistry

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice dentistry unless he possesses a current valid license from the Board of Dentistry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any felony or any crime involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of any felony or the conviction of any crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of alcohol or drugs to the extent that such use renders the licensee unsafe to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of alcohol or drugs to the extent that such use renders him unsafe to practice dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any unprofessional conduct likely to defraud or to deceive the public or patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any unprofessional conduct likely to defraud or to deceive the public or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene which causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentional or negligent conduct in the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene which causes or is likely to cause injury to a patient or patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or assisting persons known or believed to be unlicensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing or assisting persons whom he knew or had reason to believe were unlicensed to practice dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing false, deceptive, misleading, or superiority-claiming advertisements relating to professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing or causing to be published in any manner an advertisement relating to his professional practice which (i) is false, deceptive or misleading, (ii) contains a claim of superiority, or (iii) violates regulations promulgated by the Board governing advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental or physical incompetence to practice with safety to patients and the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental or physical incompetence to practice his profession with safety to his patients and the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating, assisting, or inducing others to violate any provision of the chapter or any Board regulation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating, assisting, or inducing others to violate any provision of this chapter or any Board regulation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conducting practice in a manner contrary to the standards of ethics of dentistry or dental hygiene
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conducting his practice in a manner contrary to the standards of ethics of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or causing others to practice in a manner that is a danger to the health and welfare of patients or the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or causing others to practice in a manner as to be a danger to the health and welfare of his patients or to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing outside the scope of the dentist's or dental hygienist's education, training, and experience
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing outside the scope of the dentist's or dental hygienist's education, training, and experience

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing a procedure subject to certification without the valid certification required by the Board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing a procedure subject to certification without such valid certification required by the Board pursuant to § 54.1-2709.1 and Board regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or restriction of a license to practice in another state, possession, territory, or foreign country
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension or restriction of a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in another state, possession or territory of the United States or foreign country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any state or federal law or regulation relating to manufacturing, distributing, dispensing, or administering drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The violation of any provision of a state or federal law or regulation relating to manufacturing, distributing, dispensing or administering drugs

definition_quote.value: the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, through surgical, nonsurgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and the maxillofacial, adjacent, and associated structures and their impact on the human body
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, through surgical, nonsurgical, or related procedures, of diseases, disorders, and conditions of the oral cavity and the maxillofacial, adjacent, and associated structures and their impact on the human body.

methods_authorized.quote: evaluation, diagnosis, prevention, and treatment, through surgical, nonsurgical, or related procedures

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe opioids subject to Board regulations; may possess and administer botulinum toxin injections for dental and cosmetic purposes with appropriate training
drug_authority.quote: a dentist may possess and administer botulinum toxin injections for cosmetic purposes, provided that the dentist has completed training and continuing education in the administration of botulinum toxin injections for cosmetic purposes

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: the Board shall require any dentist who provides or administers sedation or anesthesia in a dental office to obtain either a conscious/moderate sedation permit or a deep sedation/general anesthesia permit issued by the Board

specialist_license_available.quote: A licensee who is qualified based on educational requirements for a specialty board certification shall only practice in the specialty for which he is qualified.

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: A licensee who is qualified based on educational requirements for a specialty board certification shall only practice in the specialty for which he is qualified.

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: Derivatives of American Dental Association approved specialty board certifications may be used to describe the type of practice if one or more dentists in the practice are certified in the specialty or if the specialty name is accompanied by the conspicuous disclosure that services are provided by a general dentist in every advertising medium in which the trade name is used.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: dental assistants or dental hygienists aiding or assisting licensed dentists, or dental assistants aiding or assisting dental hygienists under the general supervision of a dentist

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: No dentist shall employ more than two dental hygienists who practice under remote supervision at one time.

value: mobile dentistry program for adults with developmental disabilities operated by the Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services' Office of Integrated Health
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A dental hygienist shall only practice under remote supervision at a federally qualified health center; charitable safety net facility; free clinic; long-term care facility; elementary or secondary school; Head Start program; mobile dentistry program for adults with developmental disabilities operated by the Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services' Office of Integrated Health; or women, infants, and children (WIC) program.

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: No person shall operate a mobile dental clinic or other portable dental operation without first registering such mobile dental clinic or other portable dental operation with the Board

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: The Board shall promulgate regulations for mobile dental clinics and other portable dental operations to ensure that patient safety is protected, appropriate dental services are rendered, and needed follow-up care is provided.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No corporation shall be formed or foreign corporation domesticated in the Commonwealth for the purpose of practicing dentistry other than a professional corporation as permitted by Chapter 7

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: The Board shall adopt regulations for the prescribing of opioids, which shall include guidelines for: 1. The treatment of acute pain, which shall include ... (ii) limitations on dosages or day supply of drugs prescribed

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: a requirement that the prescriber request and review information contained in the Prescription Monitoring Program in accordance with § 54.1-2522.1

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: Any licensed dentist who employs the services of any person, firm, or corporation not working in a dental office under the dentist's direct supervision to construct or repair an appliance extraorally shall furnish such person, firm, or corporation with a written or digital work order on forms prescribed by the Board

teledentistry_authorized.quote: "Teledentistry" means the delivery of dentistry between a patient and a dentist who holds a license to practice dentistry issued by the Board through the use of telehealth systems and electronic technologies or media, including interactive, two-way audio or video.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A dentist may also authorize a dental hygienist under his direction to administer Schedule VI nitrous oxide and oxygen inhalation analgesia and, to persons 18 years of age or older, Schedule VI local anesthesia. In its regulations, the Board of Dentistry shall establish the education and training requirements for dental hygienists to administer such controlled substances under a dentist's direction.

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: A dentist may also authorize a dental hygienist under his direction to administer Schedule VI nitrous oxide and oxygen inhalation analgesia

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The person, firm, or corporation shall retain the original written work order or an electronic copy of a digital work order, and the dentist shall retain a duplicate of the written work order or an electronic copy of a digital work order, for three years.

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, a dental hygienist may practice dental hygiene under the remote supervision of a dentist who holds an active license by the Board and who has a dental practice physically located in the Commonwealth.
